parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of contributing behaviors for the specified company. By default only active contributing behaviors are returned; pass all=true to include inactive ones.

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with a status of 'active'.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction. Use the value to sort ascending, or prefix with a hyphen (e.g. -name) to sort descending.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Both active and inactive Contributing Behaviors

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the contributing behavior.

name.description: Translated display name of the contributing behavior.

name_key.description: Untranslated name of the contributing behavior, matching the original value stored in the database.

active.description: Whether this contributing behavior is available for selection on incident records. When false, existing references are preserved but new assignments are prevented.

global.description: Whether this contributing behavior is a Procore-provided default. Global contributing behaviors cannot be deleted and their names cannot be changed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this contributing behavior was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this contributing behavior was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
